# Testing your app

We're now ready to test the code and features in our app-package.

## New topics {#sec-tests-new-topics}

I've updated this section for version 4.0.0 of `covr` and version 0.6.0 of `shinytest2`. Both releases change how we run and measure tests in an app-package, so I've added the topics below:

*   @sec-tests-system-coverage: `covr::package_coverage()` now counts the app code our `shinytest2` tests run. In `sap`, the system tests raise test coverage from 25% to almost 80%.

*   @sec-test-branch-coverage: `covr` can now report which branches of an `if` statement our tests take, not just which lines they run.

*   @sec-tests-system-shinytest2-bdd: our system tests now pass the `launch_app` function to `AppDriver$new()`. This lets the tests run against the installed package, which is how `R CMD check` and `covr` run them.

*   @sec-tests-system-shinytest2: `use_shinytest2()` no longer creates a `setup-shinytest2.R` file, because `load_app_env()` has been superseded.

Before `covr` 4.0.0, only our unit and module tests counted toward test coverage. The diagram below shows how the system tests now reach the code the other tests can't:

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-align: center
%%| fig-cap: 'Tests that count toward coverage with covr 4.0.0'
%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'fontFamily': 'monospace', "fontSize":"16px", "primaryColor":"#D7EBEC", "primaryTextColor":"#1B3B3F", "primaryBorderColor":"#2A6F77", "lineColor":"#5A7F83", "edgeLabelBackground":"#FFFFFF", "clusterBkg":"#F3F8F8", "clusterBorder":"#2A6F77", "darkMode":false}}}%%

flowchart TD
    subgraph Tests["<strong>tests/testthat/</strong>"]
        U("Unit tests<br><code>test_that()</code>")
        M("Module tests<br><code>testServer()</code>")
        S("System tests<br><code>AppDriver</code>")
    end
    subgraph Code["<strong>R/</strong>"]
        F("Utility functions")
        MS("Module server functions")
        APP("<code>launch_app()</code>,<br>UI, and server")
    end
    U --> F
    M --> MS
    S --> MS
    S -->|"new in covr 4.0.0"| APP
    F --> COV[/"<code>covr::package_coverage()</code>"/]
    MS --> COV
    APP --> COV

    classDef term fill:#2A6F77,color:#FFFFFF,stroke:#1B4F55,stroke-width:1px
    classDef step fill:#D7EBEC,color:#1B3B3F,stroke:#2A6F77,stroke-width:1px
    classDef decision fill:#F4C26B,color:#3D2A00,stroke:#B7832B,stroke-width:1px
    classDef io fill:#FFFFFF,color:#1B3B3F,stroke:#2A6F77,stroke-width:1px
    class U,M,S,F,MS,APP step
    class COV io

    style Code fill:#F3F8F8,color:#1B3B3F,stroke:#2A6F77,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:4 3
```
